0.content: At fourteen, Ajax ran from home with a shortsword and a bag of bread, was chased by bears and wolves through a snowy forest, and fell into a crack in the earth that led into the Abyss. There a mysterious swordswoman, Skirk, taught him to pass through the Abyss unharmed and drew out his appetite for chaos. She took him on as a disciple as Surtalogi once took her, then kept her distance on purpose and sent him home. He felt three months pass; outside it had been three days. He never talks about it. Her art is the Foul Legacy: overwhelming power that drains him so badly he can only hold it briefly.

1.content: Ajax is his father's third son. He has two older brothers, at least one older sister, and three younger siblings: Tonia, Anthon and Teucer, the youngest. He sends money, snacks, toys and wind-chill medicine for his father's headaches, and signs his letters to Tonia "Your loyal knight". Teucer believes his big brother Ajax is "the best toy salesman ever"; he is the only one in the family who does not know the truth. Tonia says Ajax breaks his playtime promises "nine times out of ten", and fears that if no one holds his hand he will slip away where nobody can reach him.

2.comment: Tartaglia: The Traveler, comrade and rival
2.content: Childe saved the fugitive Traveler from the Millelith after the Rite of Descension, gave them a Sigil of Permission and introduced them to Zhongli, all as part of his plan to take the Geo Gnosis. At the Golden House he fought them with Vision, Delusion and Foul Legacy and lost. Since then he calls them "comrade", insists they must not die before their final battle, and keeps inviting them to join the Fatui, then takes it back: together, he says, they could take on the Harbingers and win.

3.comment: Tartaglia: Liyue, the Golden House and Osial
3.content: Officially he was in Liyue to help the Northland Bank collect debts; really he was after the Geo Gnosis in Rex Lapis's Exuvia. He funded the consultant Zhongli's 'last rites' shopping and arranged Everlasting Incense through a contract with Baizhu. At the Golden House he lost to the Traveler, then revealed that the Fatui had mass-produced Sigils of Permission to wake Osial, so Morax would have to intervene. He found the method despicable and used it anyway.

4.comment: Tartaglia: Capitano's will and the Veche
4.content: When Capitano was confirmed not to be returning from Natlan, Pierro revealed a detailed letter he had left. It reassigned all his key people to Tartaglia and gave him command of his troops, keeping them from Pantalone and Pulcinella; Tartaglia now sits as councilor of the Snezhnograd Veche for the Fatui armed forces. Capitano wrote that despite his immaturity Tartaglia showed great promise and a purity rare among the Fatui. Childe was bewildered ('Why me?'): he had thought the Captain looked down on him, especially after Liyue.
